page_title: OrbStack · Fast, light, simple Docker & Linux

sources.entry: OrbStack - Fast, light, and simple way to run Docker containers and Linux machines on macOS. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: OrbStack
summary.one_liner: OrbStack is a macOS app for running Docker containers and Linux machines as a lightweight alternative to Docker Desktop.
use_cases: replace Docker Desktop on a Mac
develop with containers on Apple Silicon
run Intel x86 containers on M1/M2 Macs
edit remote Linux machines in VS Code
sandbox untrusted code in isolated machines
summary.what_it_does: OrbStack runs Docker containers, Kubernetes, and Linux machines on macOS. It includes a native Swift app, a menu bar and Activity Monitor integration, and a command line interface for running commands and copying files between Mac and Linux. Linux machines can be set up with a choice of 16 distros, with SSH, SSH agent forwarding, and remote VS Code editing. Containers and machines can reach each other over the network, with IPv6, local domain names, and VPN-friendly networking. The page claims low background CPU and disk use, with Rosetta x86 emulation for running Intel workloads on Apple Silicon.
notable: Drop-in replacement for Docker Desktop with Rosetta x86 emulation
Native Swift app with menu bar and Activity Monitor integration
Linux machines with 16 distros, SSH, and remote VS Code
Claims under 0.1% background CPU and under 10 MB disk use out of the box
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing marks it as Freeware, but this is not confirmed on the page itself
Performance claims come from the vendor and testimonials, with one time-to-provision comparison dated August 2023
